content: In 2 Chronicles, if God's people humble themselves and pray, what will He heal?
explanation: He will hear and forgive. “then I will hear from heaven, forgive their sin, and heal their land.” (2 Chronicles 7:14, BSB)

content: In 2 Chronicles, when Solomon finished praying, what came down from heaven?
explanation: It consumed the offerings. “When Solomon had finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering” (2 Chronicles 7:1, BSB)

content: In 2 Chronicles, what did Solomon ask God for to lead the people?
explanation: God gave him riches too. “Now grant me wisdom and knowledge, so that I may lead this people.” (2 Chronicles 1:10, BSB)

content: In 2 Chronicles, when a vast army came against Judah, to whom did the battle belong?
explanation: Do not be afraid. “for the battle does not belong to you, but to God.” (2 Chronicles 20:15, BSB)

content: In 2 Chronicles, who went out in front of King Jehoshaphat's army?
explanation: God set ambushes for the enemy. “and appointed those who would sing to the LORD and praise the splendor of His holiness.” (2 Chronicles 20:21, BSB)

content: In 2 Chronicles, which queen came to test Solomon with hard questions?
explanation: She brought camels with spices and gold. “Now when the queen of Sheba heard about the fame of Solomon, she came to test him with difficult questions.” (2 Chronicles 9:1, BSB)

content: In 2 Chronicles, why could the priests not minister in the new temple?
explanation: God's glory filled the house. “so that the priests could not stand there to minister because of the cloud” (2 Chronicles 5:14, BSB)

content: In 2 Chronicles, what did the singers proclaim when the temple filled with a cloud?
explanation: His love endures forever. “For He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.” (2 Chronicles 5:13, BSB)

content: In 2 Chronicles, where do the eyes of the LORD roam?
explanation: He strengthens the fully devoted. “For the eyes of the LORD roam to and fro over all the earth” (2 Chronicles 16:9, BSB)

content: In 2 Chronicles, what broke out on King Uzziah when he burned incense in the temple?
explanation: Only priests could burn incense. “leprosy broke out on his forehead.” (2 Chronicles 26:19, BSB)

content: In 2 Chronicles, King Hezekiah said Assyria had only what on its side?
explanation: God was with Judah. “With him is only the arm of flesh, but with us is the LORD our God to help us” (2 Chronicles 32:8, BSB)

content: In 2 Chronicles, after God answered his prayer, what did King Manasseh know?
explanation: He humbled himself in distress. “Then Manasseh knew that the LORD is God.” (2 Chronicles 33:13, BSB)

content: In 2 Chronicles, which Persian king did God stir to send a proclamation?
explanation: It fulfilled Jeremiah's word. “the LORD stirred the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia to send a proclamation” (2 Chronicles 36:22, BSB)

content: In 2 Chronicles, what did Cyrus say God appointed him to build?
explanation: God's people could go home. “has appointed me to build a house for Him at Jerusalem in Judah.” (2 Chronicles 36:23, BSB)

content: In 2 Chronicles, how many years did King Joash reign in Jerusalem?
explanation: He began at seven years old. “and he reigned in Jerusalem forty years.” (2 Chronicles 24:1, BSB)

content: In 2 Chronicles, which priest went in after King Uzziah to stop him?
explanation: Eighty brave priests went with him. “Then Azariah the priest, along with eighty brave priests of the LORD, went in after him.” (2 Chronicles 26:17, BSB)

content: In 2 Chronicles, in which year of his reign did young Josiah begin to seek God?
explanation: He later cleansed Judah of idols. “In the eighth year of his reign, while he was still young, Josiah began to seek the God of his father David” (2 Chronicles 34:3, BSB)

content: In 2 Chronicles, when did the LORD set ambushes against Judah's enemies?
explanation: Praise came before victory. “The moment they began their shouts and praises, the LORD set ambushes” (2 Chronicles 20:22, BSB)
